description: The plot, titled "Search Space of M-Cube," illustrates the relationship between the number of missing pieces and the number of possible solutions for two different conditions. The x-axis is labeled "# Missing pieces" and features a linear scale ranging from 1 to 6, with tick marks at regular intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled "# Possible solutions" and employs a logarithmic scale (base 10), with visible tick marks ranging from $10^2$ to $10^8$ at intervals of $10^2$. The plot contains two solid lines with circular markers. The first line is orange (its legend label is obscured by a grey box) and demonstrates a steady upward trend across the x-axis, starting at approximately $10^1$ at x=1 and increasing to exactly $10^8$ at x=6. The final data point on this line at x=6 is enclosed in a red circle and annotated with the red text "CUBE". The second line, labeled "Flip ignored" in the legend, is light blue and also exhibits a steady upward trend. It begins at a value slightly below $10^1$ at x=1 and rises to approximately $3 \times 10^6$ at x=6. The data point on the light blue line at x=2 is enclosed in a red circle and annotated with the red text "CUBE-easy".
